parameters.query:
SELECT v.claim_ref, v.status, v.product, to_char(v.incident_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS incident_date,
       v.reported_at, v.updated_at, v.timeline
FROM (SELECT 1) AS one
LEFT JOIN claim_status_public v ON v.claim_ref = $1;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "not_found", "message": "No claim found for that reference and link." } }}

parameters.content:
## Claim Status API
`GET /webhook/claims/status?ref=CLM-…&t=<token>`

- `t` = HMAC of the ref (signed link from our emails / 202). Wrong or missing token → **same 404** as an unknown claim, so refs can't be enumerated
- Reads only the `claim_status_public` view
- Internal statuses mapped to public ones: fraud review looks like "Under review" (no tipping off)
